mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category ( name, description, is_active, is_deleted, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{description}, #{isActive}, #{isDeleted}, now(), #{createdBy}, now(), #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, is_active = #{isActive}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted}, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.select: SELECT category_id, name, description, is_active, is_deleted, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by FROM category WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT category_id, name, description, is_active, is_deleted, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by FROM category
name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' AND is_active = #{active} AND is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY
name updated_at created_at
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{__limit} OFFSET #{__offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM category
name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' AND is_active = #{active} AND is_deleted = 0
